versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-dedup.

- Supports automatic download, watermark removal, deep deduplication (remix), and audio removal for Douyin videos via URL.
- Processes include segment shuffling, crop/scale, mirroring, brightness adjustment, noise, and speed changes.
- Outputs deduplicated video file ready for use.
- Simple command-line usage and troubleshooting guidance included.
- Requires ffmpeg, yt-dlp, and Python 3.
